summary: Fixed cargo/Rust false-negative in task_executor toolchain setup by adding a cargo|rustc|rustup case to mac_install_command. The fix promotes an existing ~/.cargo/bin installation into MAC_TOOLCHAIN_BIN (fast path) and falls back to rustup download when absent. Added 2 passing tests; 144 tests pass, 2 pre-existing unrelated failures unchanged.

codegraph.note: Change is internal to task_executor.py shell string. No public API changes. Affected test files are transitive but unchanged; callers are within the same module.

assumptions: The two pre-existing test failures (test_git_finalizer_blocks_when_canonical_remote_is_missing, test_repository_contract_canonical_branch_empty_when_absent) were present before this change and are unrelated to cargo/Rust toolchain setup.
The api test failure test_repository_ref_reconciler_follows_app_lifecycle is a MAC_API_TOKEN environment issue unrelated to this change.
cargo installations live at $CARGO_HOME/bin (defaulting to ~/.cargo/bin) which is not in MAC_SANDBOX_BASE_PATH; the fix correctly promotes existing installations into MAC_TOOLCHAIN_BIN.
The rustup fallback uses curl -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --no-modify-path, consistent with the official Rust installation method.
